verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a rendered OpenAPI reference at api.secureframe.com/docs, and the page source embeds the full "openapi: 3.0.0" Secureframe API definition. That makes a machine-readable spec obtainable, but only by pulling it out of roughly 490KB of page source; no direct download is documented. A dated versioning policy adds some stability for consumers of the spec. Missing for 10: a documented raw-spec download URL (e.g. openapi.json/yaml), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the embedded spec is complete and current.
